headline: Make complex decisions feel clearer.
subheadline: Harbor is a calm, editorial prebuild for professional services that need to explain their value and invite confident next steps.
description: Built for trust-heavy work, Harbor gives service stories room to breathe, brings proof and resources into view, and makes lead capture feel considered rather than pushy. Its restrained palette, generous spacing, and crisp typography bring a modern editorial character without defaulting to corporate blue.
card_blurb: Clear service stories, thoughtful proof, and reassuring lead capture—with an editorial feel beyond corporate blue.
seo_description: A polished professional-services website prebuild with clear service pages, thoughtful proof, useful resources, and calm, confident lead capture.
image_notes: Favor architectural details, considered workspaces, and quiet coastal textures over handshake clichés.
Use natural light and a muted palette of warm neutrals, deep ink, and restrained harbor-inspired tones.
Choose documentary-style portraits that feel composed and approachable, not overly staged.
Keep image crops spacious and uncluttered so service copy and calls to action stay easy to scan.
